canDoYue: 你識訂一個夠十個人食嘅芒果蛋糕，寫上生日訊息，星期六三點取，加八枝蠟燭，同付二百蚊訂金。
canDoEn: Order a mango cake for ten people, add a birthday message and eight candles, pay a two-hundred-dollar deposit, and pick it up Saturday at three.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like a cake in a size for ten people, please.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我想要一個夠十個人食嘅蛋糕。
dialogue.say: Hi. I'd like a cake in a size for ten people, please.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Sure. What flavour would you like, chocolate or mango?
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。你想要朱古力味定芒果味？
dialogue.say: Sure. What flavour would you like, chocolate or mango?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Mango, please. Can you write Happy birthday Mei on it?
dialogue.glossYue: 芒果，唔該。上面可唔可以寫 Happy birthday Mei？
dialogue.say: Mango, please. Can you write Happy birthday Mei on it?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Yes. We can add that message. When do you want to pick it up?
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。我哋可以加上句訊息。你想幾時取？
dialogue.say: Yes. We can add that message. When do you want to pick it up?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Saturday at three, please. Do you have candles too?
dialogue.glossYue: 星期六三點，唔該。你哋有冇蠟燭？
dialogue.say: Saturday at three, please. Do you have candles too?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll add eight candles. A deposit of two hundred holds the cake.
dialogue.glossYue: 有，我會加八枝蠟燭。二百蚊訂金可以留住個蛋糕。
dialogue.say: Yes, I'll add eight candles. A deposit of two hundred holds the cake.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: That's fine. Can I pay the deposit by card?
dialogue.glossYue: 好。我可唔可以用卡付訂金？
dialogue.say: That's fine. Can I pay the deposit by card?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Of course. Your cake will be ready at three on Saturday.
dialogue.glossYue: 當然可以。你個蛋糕星期六三點可以取。
dialogue.say: Of course. Your cake will be ready at three on Saturday.
